description: The ip2location vendor module in replace mode (SID_MODULES=geo,ip2location, SID_MODULE_CONFIG={"ip2location":{"mode":"replace"}}): IP2Location's country always, with ipservice 1, and, listed after geo, it wins the merge; geo's other fields stay. The traffic signal is unaffected by mode. The country fixture maps 192.0.2.0/25 to FR and the proxy fixture maps 192.0.2.0/26 to tor.

cases.name: replaces the CDN's country, keeping geo's other fields, and sends the proxy signal
